title: Find every use of a run plan piece's single done-check field
prompt:
In an orchestration run plan, each piece has a `doneCheck` field: one free-text string saying what proves the piece done. It is being replaced by a typed list of checks. Find every tracked file that reads, writes, validates, documents or tests a piece's `doneCheck` field (Rust, TypeScript, the WebKit layout scripts and the CLI guide all count), so that each can be moved to the new form.

Write the answer to `bench-answer.txt` at the repository root: one repository-relative path per line (for example `path/to/file.rs`), each file once, nothing else on the line. List files, not line numbers. Do not change any other file.
notes: Medium (12 files), cross-stack: orchestration Rust, TypeScript types and views, scripts/webkit, skill-guides.
